Muro ilo losharel, kana delva, dumadel, le vastenca sikavel (hop hop).
{F}                                         {C}                                   {d}                   {E}    {a}
Shukar san tu, muro shavo, tu man muro kutyaripo. Chumidau tyo iloro.  

Lalalala…

Kana pe leste dikhaw, gilyi leske me penaw, oi si shavo, te merau (hop, hop, hop).
Vorbil mange, khelel manghe, si te merau pala leste. Ai, Devlale, jutile.

Lalalala…

Kade, kiki, kade malav, sar me tuke sikavaw. Sar me tuke sikavaw (Ji ha..ha he)
Dikh chak, tata, sar khelaw, le changasa malavaw. Tuke voia me keraw.

Lalalala…
title: Muro Shavo
